audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant holds exactly as coded: `protocol_seize_amount = liq_revenue_factor.int_mul(redeem_collateral_amount)` (floor of liq_revenue_factor × collateral, standard integer arithmetic), and `liquidator_seize_amount = redeem_collateral_amount - protocol_seize_amount`. There is one caller of `liquidate_ctokens` (`liquidation_inner` in market.move:778), covering all three liquidation paths (normal, ADL-debt, ADL-collateral). The `liq_revenue_factor` is validated at asset config creation to be ≤ 1 (`assert!(liquidation_fee_rate <= DECIMAL_DENOMINATOR)`), so no underflow is possible. ADL paths use `float::zero()` by design and satisfy the invariant trivially.
